lowering.source_order: The current six-manifest literal_index is a complete topological permutation. A repeated source-node reference in any future input must retain one descriptor identity rather than duplicate the resolved value.
lowering.entry_roots: Each entry literal_index range becomes one contiguous C2 resolution range. Internal list-tail pairs are emitted before that range.
lowering.list: One shared NIL descriptor is added in every image that contains a LIST. A LIST of N>0 children becomes N backward-only cons descriptors; its head occupies the original root slot.
lowering.cons: Legacy CONS becomes one backward-only cons descriptor.
lowering.pair_reference_rule: Both descriptor ordinals are strictly below the pair descriptor ordinal; self and forward references are format errors.
lowering.resolver: One forward pass over descriptors; no recursive decoder walk.
lowering.sharing: Two edges to the same descriptor ordinal resolve to the same object identity. Sharing may not be reconstructed by value.

symbol_provenance.kind5_emission_rule: Only explicit compiler edge provenance naming a declared export may emit kind 5; spelling equality is insufficient.
symbol_provenance.call_graph_consumers: Tree-shaking, who-calls, ide-help cross-references and every future call-graph consumer read only kind 5. Kind 8 is invisible.

strict_version_boundary: The future product decoder accepts C2I-v2 only. Historical C2I-v1 proof decoders reject v2; no product contains both.
